results.title: Medea Research
results.overview: I’m looking for Medea. I investigate what we know about her, what we don’t say, and what she teaches us about ourselves. A text emerges: Medea-Material, by Heiner Müller. We lend our voices to this character – perhaps this time we’ll be able to hear her.

results.title: BLUNT
results.overview: When your knife turns blunt, do you sharpen it or let it become a glorified butter knife at dad's company brunches? Something only you can answer.

results.title: With Oak
results.overview: When a focus group of consumers is asked for their opinion, it quickly becomes clear that the company's attempt at inclusivity may have missed the mark.

results.original_title: Yo cazatesoros: El quinto del rey

results.title: Confidante
results.overview: Ankara, 1999. Arzu takes one call after another in the sex call centre where she works. When an earthquake hits Istanbul, a young client she spoke to earlier phones her back, begging her to rescue him from the rubble.

results.title: CBeebies Panto: Cinderella
results.overview: Join Cinderella, Buttons and some funny new characters for a story that celebrates finding your thing! Sparkling with CBeebies’ stars, this unique adaption of a pantomime classic is full of music, magic and festive fun for all the family - plus a song exclusive to cinemas!

results.title: Emma
results.overview: A restaurant becomes a nightmarish stage where male bodies morph into pigs—a transformation that embodies the dehumanization experienced by the victim. The familiar veers into the abject, the visual and auditory saturation replicating the traumatic invasion.

results.title: 12A Railway Colony
results.overview: When easygoing Karthik falls head over heels for his charming neighbour, he thinks love is simple. But the closer he gets, the more tangled his world becomes, full of hidden truths, shocking lies, and unexpected twists

results.title: Pirâmides
results.overview: Yasmin sees her life change forever when a gigantic pyramid looms over her town, causing almost everyone to disappear. Now, she must face a series of highly unusual challenges alongside a group of completely clueless survivors - while dealing with some absolutely annoying aliens.

results.title: LIVE ACTION
results.overview: While observing pre-recorded surveillance footage of three criminals, a mysterious character narrates the backstory and psychology of the three subjects, all while questioning our very existence.

results.title: Goose Ridge
results.overview: Xiao, a young boy, wakes to find his mother missing. The only clue given to Xiao comes from a strange woman who claims she and his mom are from a place called Goose Ridge. However, when Xiao asks around, everyone else insists the place doesn't exist.

results.title: Do Not Watch This Film
results.overview: A chilling descent into obsession, perception, and the invisible chains of technology. When a socially isolated tech genius named Arnie discovers a mysterious VHS tape titled “Do Not Watch This Film,” he’s exposed to a reality altering signal—a broadcast not meant for human eyes. From that moment, something changes in him. Driven by a vision of a perfect, screen-based world, Arnie creates a powerful algorithm and his own signal that transforms any screen into his new reality.

results.title: Fabulosas – Operação Aranha
results.overview: In a frozen city, trans journalist Leôncia seeks justice for the murder of a friend, uncovering a web of secrets and an enigmatic figure with supernatural powers. Fabulosas: Operação Aranha explores the strength of a community united to survive and pursue justice on its own terms—even if that means confronting the supernatural, or becoming part of it.

results.title: Peacock
results.overview: A group of boys get invited to a party by the popular girl at school. They exude confidence on their way to see her, only to be taught a valuable life lesson on masculinity.

results.title: Cher Zoscar
results.overview: The film Cher Zoscar is a correspondence between the desire to create and life swallowing you up. Something like that.

results.title: The Cheerleader...
results.overview: After a young cheerleader, Niamh, works her back from an injury, she finds out she has been replaced by her team.

results.title: Cuadro negro
results.overview: Sofía, a young journalist immersed in making an artistic documentary about the Chilean army, goes back to live with her grandmother after a breakdown in a relationship. There she meets María, a woman whose view of the military legacy contrasts with that of her grandmother, reflecting the tensions of a country marked by its history.

results.title: LUNA
results.overview: Luna begins a new chapter of her life, overwhelmed by doubt in an unfamiliar home. Her first morning becomes a reflective journey into childhood memories, particularly her complex relationship with her mother. These reflections reshape her identity, prompting her to question her understanding of love, family, and herself. As Luna navigates the unknown with optimism, the uncharted blends with the familiar, challenging her perceptions.
